design: Setup A only (random three folds, rotations from v1). Network with the paper's 144-setting grid and an 8-fit average, and ridge on the same 10 inputs, folds and rows. Each model trained and evaluated on abnormal return and on net return separately. Same 90% coverage rule, 5th/95th bounds and block bootstrap as the v2 spread.
statement: Registered before the network or ridge-on-10-inputs was run. The v2 spread for the two-input ridge and momentum had already been seen. Setup A lets training use months after the test month, so results are a retrospective diagnostic, not a real-time forecast.
departures: Lagged features (setup C timing), not same-month flow. Family inputs drop the all-siblings rule and are built from the panel, so sub-floor siblings do not count.
run: 2026-11-17. Results in reports/2026-11-17-setup-a-network-results.md. The network learned almost nothing; its net-return model collapsed to constant predictions in 30 of 81 months, so that row is an artefact of the fund-ID tie rule.
